create_cache_redis: create a Redis cache for LiteLLM with host, port, password, and namespace configuration
create_cache_s3: create an S3 cache for LiteLLM with bucket name, region, and AWS credential parameters
create_cache_qdrant_semantic: create a Qdrant semantic cache for LiteLLM with API base, collection name, and similarity threshold
create_cache_enable: enable caching globally for LiteLLM with type, host, port, and supported call types
create_cache_update: update the global LiteLLM cache configuration with new type, host, port, and password settings
